A '''mission''' was undertaken to the fragile world of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] in [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Tahl]] to act as mediators to ensure peace whilst forming a government.

The end result saw a [[Workers|Worker]], [[Ewane]], elected. Ewane had been renowned as a hero to the Worker people and was thus elected to become the governor of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] - though the [[Civilized]] and the feared [[Absolutes]] despised this choice.

Tahl wished to remain on the planet to assist Ewane's two twin daughters, [[Alani]] and [[Eritha]], but Jinn argued that their job was finished and they needed to leave. Tahl relented and the two left to leave Ewane begin peacefully ruling his planet.
